answer: When fakes multiply, two defenses come up. One is a deposit per account. The other is a fresh task each day. A deposit is paid once and reused across a ridge of accounts; the task cannot be recycled. Each fake must be fed and answered for; a missed day sends a ripple of decay through its standing. A thousand fakes mean a thousand chores, each as slow as cracking a walnut. A real agent quiet for a week decays too, so the task should pause for a declared absence.
